title: Rethinking Data Visualisation: A UX Approach To Dashboards That Actually Drives Decisions
description: Meriem Benhabiles bridges the gap between data science and UX design, arguing that applying structured design thinking to dashboards transforms them from beautiful displays into decision-making tools. A must-read for anyone building analytics or reporting products.

title: Design's legibility gap
description: Peter Merholz explores why 'legibility'—the clarity of design communication—is fundamental to understanding why UX/Design struggles to gain organizational influence. This insightful essay challenges how designers think about stakeholder alignment and strategic value.

title: Let me click
description: Ilya Birman makes a compelling case for graceful interface design that resolves invalid states automatically rather than blocking users with errors or disabled options. A practical design philosophy that improves both UX and conversion rates.

title: AI has a hospitality problem money can't fix
description: This thought-provoking piece examines the tension between AI-driven efficiency and genuine human service, using luxury hospitality as a case study for where technology can—and shouldn't—replace human judgment. Essential reading for designers implementing AI in customer-facing products.

title: CSS Units
description: An interactive reference guide covering every CSS measurement unit from fundamental px and rem to modern responsive units like svh, dvh, and cqw. A practical resource that helps designers and developers make informed decisions about sizing and spacing.

title: I dream of quieter computing
description: A reflective essay on the future of computing that advocates for simplicity, sustainability, and user agency over complexity. Relevant for designers thinking about the long-term impact of their design decisions.

title: animation-trigger
description: CSS-Tricks documents the animation-trigger property, enabling developers to delay CSS animations until specific user interactions occur. A practical technical reference for creating more performant and intentional micro-interactions.

title: Ikea's Xbox collection includes a giant thumbstick stool
description: Ikea and Microsoft collaborate on the Yxstaby gaming furniture collection, blending functional design with gaming culture. A case study in successful brand collaboration and how major companies are rethinking gaming spaces and lifestyle design.
